performed_by: root maintainer, independent of world_a09 material author

offline.method: Independent offline reconstruction; embedded export ICC reused for binary identity because profile creation timestamps are nondeterministic

browser.instrumentation: Only MeshStandardMaterial/Texture/Light/WebGLRenderer runtime observation; no rendering or geometry mutations. Query nonce plus CDP cache disable; verify each HTTP body SHA against frozen production source.

limits: Finite native/repeat/GPU visual review, not mathematical seamlessness
Grass and leaf clusters repeat periodically; individual edge leaves are not curve-continuous
Preview WebP is lossy; exact-byte reconstruction is not PNG pixel equivalence
Material test page is not actual game integration or mobile performance
